Name: masterswarm
Version: 1.1.2

The masterswarm skill is a legitimate API connector designed to interface with the MasterSwarm cloud service for multi-engine AI document analysis. It requires a user-provided API key (MASTERSWARM_API_KEY) and sends data to a documented external endpoint (api.neurodoc.app), which is consistent with its stated purpose. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration of sensitive local files, or unauthorized execution was found in SKILL.md or the metadata.
